t: Subsection (b) of section 4651 of title 39, United States Code, is amended by striking out “6 cents for each two ounces or fraction thereof” and inserting in lieu thereof “14 cents for the first two ounces or fraction thereof, and 7 cents for each additional two ounces or fraction thereof,”.

fable.w: This section only amends a statutory postal rate, replacing one dollar figure with another directly in the statute. There is no tempting participatory reading: it involves no rulemaking, comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.

opus.w: The section only changes the postage rate in 39 U.S.C. 4651(b), from "6 cents for each two ounces" to a new tiered rate. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority, or right to sue for anyone outside the federal government. A procedural reading fails because Congress sets the rate directly in the statute, with no outside input.
